verdict.rationale: Anrok's Transactions API syncs transactions from your billing system, and createOrUpdate saves each transaction against the right tax return. There is also evidence of Stripe and Shopify integrations alongside the API, so multiple channels can feed filings. However, the pack shows only those two named connectors and no documented historical backfill path, so whole-business coverage is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/historical backfill import docs, a documented catalog of connectors for other processors and storefronts, evidence that multi-source transactions are consolidated into one filing, and independent hands-on corroboration.
